name: EWA Splatting with kNN Covariance Estimation
definition: A rendering method that uses per-point 3D covariance estimated from k-nearest neighbours to project an elliptical weighted average (EWA) shape onto the 2D image plane for denser coverage than simple disk splatting.
summary: EWA Splatting with kNN Covariance Estimation adapts kernel footprints to local point density using k-nearest neighbor covariance, reducing holes in sparse regions and preventing overlap in dense regions.
